                   EVERGY MISSOURI METRO’S NOTICE OF ERRATA
                     TO TRUE-UP DIRECT OF WITNESS HSIN FOO

         COME NOW, Evergy Metro, Inc. d/b/a Evergy Missouri Metro (“EMM” or the

 “Company”), by and through their counsel and, for their Notice of Errata (“Errata”), states to the

 Missouri Public Service Commission (“Commission”) as follows:

       1.     On September 10, 2026, the Company filed true-up direct testimony of Company

witness Hsin Foo (the “Testimony”) in this docket.

       2.     A correction to the Testimony needs to be made at p. 3 lns. 18-21, as follows:

              Q:      What Wwere there any changes in load requirements reflected in the true-

                      up filing?

              A:       Yes. As discussed contained in the surrebuttal workpapers provided by

                       Company witness Mr. Bass, net system input increased by approximately

                       three percent relative to the net system input in the Company’s production cost

                       model in direct filing. The change for large load customers is explained in my

                       workpapers.
